necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia, reporting persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities. To further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, a 48-hour Holter monitor has been ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of correlating symptoms with rhythm disturbances as documented in the case facts.
